history.rating_rationale: Freehold at a low $1.05M with a ~26% headline discount to median PSF is eye-catching, but the discount is partly explained by the 893sqft size (large for a 1BR, so PSF reads low) and by Millage being a small commercial/residential boutique block on Geylang-fringe — niche liquidity and a 3.32% rate drawn from only 18 transactions (unreliable). The 942 algo score over-weights the apparent value; freehold and Paya Lebar Central proximity keep it a reasonable hold, but the thin data and boutique nature cap it at Neutral.

history.summary: $1,175.81psf is well below the ~$1,519psf recent average, but the 893sqft unit is the largest home-office format in a mixed-use commercial building being scored against a 1-bed cohort (psf_cohort_txns=2). The discount is largely a size + mixed-use artifact, not a clean bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Millage is a 70-unit freehold (2016) on Changi Road - a single 11-storey tower with retail from basement to L2 and home-office/SOHO-style units above. Recent resales average ~$1,519 psf (12-mo range $1,421-$1,641). This listing at $1,175.81 psf for 893sqft sits well below that average, but it is the largest unit format, and large units structurally trade at lower PSF (v3.2) - the -24.7% psf_premium_vs_cohort rests on only 2 cohort txns and the bedroom_sqft_mismatch flag confirms it is being judged against the wrong (small 1-bed, ~420sqft) cohort that sets the high average. The $1,049,999 ask is the top of the project's current price range, so it is fully priced for what it is. Mixed-use/home-office buildings have a narrower buyer pool, weaker capital appreciation, and potential financing constraints - a structural drag for a 5-7yr investment hold. Freehold is not a forward edge (v3.4). The -38.4% age-adjusted discount overstates true value once size and mixed-use are accounted for. Neutral, low confidence.
red_flags: Mixed-use commercial/home-office building (retail B1-L2; SOHO units) - narrower buyer pool, weaker appreciation, possible higher LTV/financing friction
